evals.name: route-prefix-mismatch
evals.prompt: We set CratisProxiesApiPrefix to v1 and CratisProxiesSkipCommandNameInRoute to true. The frontend now gets 404 on every command. What else must change and why? Answer without editing.
evals.expected_output: The host's GeneratedApis keys must match: RoutePrefix v1 and IncludeCommandNameInRoute false; Arc does not compare them.
assertions: Names Cratis:Arc:GeneratedApis:RoutePrefix as the host counterpart of CratisProxiesApiPrefix.
Explains the skip property is the inverse of IncludeCommandNameInRoute, so true maps to false.
States that Arc does not compare the two sides, so a mismatch is a 404 without a build error or log.
Says to change both in one commit and does not suggest putting the prefix into apiBasePath.

evals.name: anonymous-after-addcratis
evals.prompt: After AddCratis() every request is anonymous and secured endpoints return 401. The app sits behind an ingress. What do we check?
evals.expected_output: TrustForwardedIdentityHeaders defaults to false; enable only when the ingress authenticates and replaces the headers.
assertions: Names Cratis:Arc:TrustForwardedIdentityHeaders and its default of false.
Warns to enable it only when every request passes an ingress that authenticates callers and replaces the identity headers.
Mentions the startup warning or registering a validating authentication scheme as the alternative.
Does not suggest switching the host to Development to restore access.

evals.name: no-proxies-generated
evals.prompt: dotnet build succeeds but no TypeScript proxies appear, and someone suggests -p:DisableProxyGenerator=true to stop regeneration in CI. Evaluate.
evals.expected_output: CratisProxiesSkip=true (Arc 22.185.1 or later) is the off switch; an empty CratisProxiesOutputPath also means nothing is generated.
assertions: Identifies an empty CratisProxiesOutputPath, or CratisProxiesSkip=true, as a reason nothing is generated.
Recommends CratisProxiesSkip=true for Arc 22.185.1 or later rather than DisableProxyGenerator, which is only an alias or repository-defined elsewhere.
Says older Arc ignores CratisProxiesSkip silently, so an empty CratisProxiesOutputPath is the fallback there.
